lines.en: I pass through the abandoned shaft.
My wings carry dust.
I fly between the timber beams.
My feathers are pale blue-green.
I skim above the rails.
Wind rises from the mine's depths.
I circle a support post.
I cross the caved-in entrance.
My wings stir coal dust.
I head toward any draft.
I rise along the shaft.
I settle on a mine cart.
I fly slowly, wary of beams.
I go around a rubble pile.
I can fly in the dark.
I trail fine dust behind me.
I fly toward the exit.
My wings echo in the shaft.
I perch on a crossbeam.
My feathers have gathered dust.
I listen to the shaft's echo.
Wind keeps rising from below.
I shake my plumage out.
I need no lamp in the dark.
I am at ease in this shaft.
My talons grip old wood.
I fold my wings slowly.
The draft tastes of the mine.
I wait for the updraft.
You brought a torch in here.
I watch you through the dust.
Your steps echo loudly here.
You should not go deeper.
I have been in this shaft a long while.
You smell of the surface.
My feathers lifted a little.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块木头不稳
lines.en: The beam you stepped on is unsound.
I perch on the beam above you.
Lift your head and look.
Dust fell from my feathers.
I retreated onto a beam.
I do not cry; the echo would be too loud.
That left me flying at an angle.
My wing scraped wood.
My wings can still beat.
The draft steadies me.
You did not reach the wing's root.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛落了灰，味道还在。
lines.en: Ash on my feathers, but the scent stays.
This shaft will remember.
Only things in the shaft suit me.
There are insects in the shaft; enough.
That is not enough in your hand.
Set it on the mine cart.
There is no lack of food here.
I will not come down for it.
It is covered in coal dust.
Put it in your pocket.
You hit the dust I shed.
My wing bone scraped the beam.
My wing struck a beam.
You gave half a pace of ground.

lines.zh: 煤灰里碰一下不算什么
lines.en: A touch in the coal dust is nothing.
I moved higher.
This shaft is far too narrow.
Dust settled on your shoulder.
Going up, you will meet me.

lines.zh: 我的蛋在石里睡了很多年
lines.en: My egg slept in stone many years.
I will not take that up.
There are no others of my kind here.
I only want a draft.
Go back to the surface.
I twisted my head aside.
No one lingers in this shaft.
The two of us do not suit.
I still have a shaft to patrol.
One hook of the talon on the rail.
It fell by the rails.
It is no bigger than a coal lump.
I lift it, then set it down.
It is covered in coal dust.
I open my talons and drop it.
Steady your hand a little.
I have no use for these.
It rolled into a stone gap.
Just bend down.
You broke that beam.
I heard that sound.
This shaft is mine.
I come down the shaft at you.
My wings spread between the shaft walls.
Go back up to the surface.
The shaft is narrow; you cannot dodge.
I cry, and the echo runs long.

lines.zh: 我在矿洞里石化，等着被唤醒。
lines.en: Petrified in a mine, I wait to be woken.
You have a few steps left.
Do not touch that old timber.
I have your position.
I follow along the shaft.
You turned to the left.
I am on the beam above you.
Do you hear the wingbeat's echo?
I know every fork here.
That one ends blind.
The air swirls beneath my wings.
Your torch is swaying.
No hurry; the shaft has no way out.
You are going deeper and deeper.
I land on the beam ahead.
The echo tells me where you are.
Your breathing is loud in this shaft.
I have stayed on this level.
I plunge down at you.
My talon tip rakes your shoulder.
You took a cut.
My wing rakes your back.
This blow comes with coal dust.
You fell back behind the cart.
I kept most of my strength back.
You brought your arms up over your face.
I pulled my wings up.
The next will come lower still.
I rise up the shaft.
Coal dust settles first.
This abandoned shaft has woken.
My wings shine in the dark.
Did you hear a long cry?

lines.zh: 我从坍塌的入口飞进来
lines.en: I fly in through the caved-in entrance.
The wind lifted me up.
I slept in this shaft a long time.
I settle above your torch.
Going up, you will meet me.
My feathers still carry stone dust.
I fly toward your lamp.
Firelight is too harsh in this shaft.
I hit a beam and dropped.

lines.zh: 矿井积水让我的羽毛发沉
lines.en: Floodwater weighs my feathers down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把矿道震塌了一角
lines.en: The blast caved in part of the shaft.
An arrow sank into my wing bone.
The spell snared my wind.
There are not enough insects here.
Thunder rolls down the shaft.
There is no wind here at all.
